verdict.rationale: Managed model inference is a fair question for a hyperscale cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a first-party inference service, a model catalog of frontier or open models, or an inference API. The pack covers only the CLI, IaC, RBAC, cost management, REST conventions, emulators and lifecycle policy, none of which counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API
